import zipfile, os

archive_path = "/tmp/galaxy_dl/Galaxy19-[scogs_animals.zip].zip"

    mafft_files = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.mafft')]
    content = z.read(mafft_files[0]).decode('utf-8')

# Parse FASTA
sequences = {}
current_name = None
current_seq = []
for line in content.strip().split('\n'):
    if line.startswith('>'):
        if current_name:
            sequences[current_name] = ''.join(current_seq)
        current_name = line[1:].strip()
        current_seq = []
    else:
        current_seq.append(line.strip())
if current_name:
    sequences[current_name] = ''.join(current_seq)

print(f"Sequences: {list(sequences.keys())}")
print(f"Alignment length: {len(sequences[list(sequences.keys())[0]])}")

import bioblend.galaxy, os

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

gi.datasets.download_dataset("f9cad7b01a4721359e7ab5754d9ca555", file_path="/tmp/galaxy_dl/animals/", maxwait=30)
# Download fungi result
gi.datasets.download_dataset("f9cad7b01a47213579d230a3f6bdedbd", file_path="/tmp/galaxy_dl/fungi/", maxwait=30)

# Read both
def read_tsv(directory):
    for f in os.listdir(directory):
        path = os.path.join(directory, f)
        with open(path) as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        lines = content.strip().split('\n')
        values = {}
        for l in lines[1:]:
            parts = l.strip().split('\t')
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                values[parts[0]] = float(parts[1])
        return len(lines), values
    return 0, {}

animals_count, animals_data = read_tsv("/tmp/galaxy_dl/animals/")
fungi_count, fungi_data = read_tsv("/tmp/galaxy_dl/fungi/")

print(f"Fungi: {fungi_count} lines, {len(fungi_data)} genes")

combined_path = "/tmp/combined_pis.tsv"
with open(combined_path, 'w') as out:
    out.write("group\tvalue\n")
    for gene, val in animals_data.items():
        out.write(f"animals\t{val:.6f}\n")
    for gene, val in fungi_data.items():
        out.write(f"fungi\t{val:.6f}\n")

# Quick stats

    file_name="combined_pis_percentages.tsv",
    file_type="tabular"
)
